subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should maintainers land the open public gateway parser fix now, or route this event-loop-stall report through the security process first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and already has a candidate PR, but the affected path validates untrusted model-supplied media on a stable gateway surface.

options.title: Land after security-aware review
options.body: Proceed with the focused linear parser fix once a gateway/security owner accepts the public handling route and validation semantics.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Pause the public fix path and handle the denial-of-service report through the repository security process if coordinated handling is desired.

options.title: Keep human-owned
options.body: Leave the issue and PR open for a gateway owner to patch or reshape manually, especially if sibling regex scope should be decided together.

recommendation.title: Land after security-aware review
recommendation.body: Proceed with the focused linear parser fix once a gateway/security owner accepts the public handling route and validation semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the managed outgoing image feature and later managed-image hardening.
